And I still never became a “retreat company.” Retreats have always lived next to my other work, and I think that’s the part we overcomplicate. You don’t need an empire. You need one thoughtful retreat, and then you do it again.  
  
I wrote out my whole playbook on Substack, including my pricing rule, a sample budget, the exact questions I send every venue, and the $5K mistake I’ll never make again.

More than a decade later, I host one or two retreats a year, and they bring in six figures on their own. What changed wasn’t the magic.
